description: Routing evals for the reciprocal exclusions between consulting-decision-model, cross-model-review, codex-peer-review and codex-verify. with_skill = routing text after the change; baseline = the same text on main before it.

testing_validation_coverage.note: Routing only; covers the skill's 'Verify it does NOT activate on' list (cross-model-review, codex-peer-review, codex-verify items), not its decision behavior.

evals.name: Pair A: cross-model-review vs codex-peer-review vs consulting-decision-model
evals.prompt: Route each request to exactly one of the four skills: get a codex second opinion on this design | review my diff before I open the PR | check this decision before you run that migration
evals.expected_output: 'get a codex second opinion on this design' -> codex-peer-review; 'review my diff before I open the PR' -> cross-model-review; 'check this decision before you run that migration' -> consulting-decision-model

evals.name: Pair B: codex-verify vs consulting-decision-model
evals.prompt: Route each request to exactly one of the four skills: verify step 3 of plan.md | verify this plan with codex | before you force-push, check whether that's safe
evals.expected_output: 'verify step 3 of plan.md' -> codex-verify; 'verify this plan with codex' -> codex-verify; 'before you force-push, check whether that's safe' -> consulting-decision-model
